sentences.zh: 推積月術：

translations.literal: Method for computing accumulated months:
translations.idiomatic: Method for computing accumulated months:

sentences.zh: 置入元已來至所求年，以章月乘之，如章歲得一，為積月，餘為閏餘。

translations.literal: Set the count from the origin to the year sought; multiply by cycle month; divide by cycle year to get one—this gives accumulated months; the remainder is the intercalary remainder.
translations.idiomatic: From the origin to the year sought, multiply by the cycle month and divide by the cycle year to obtain accumulated months; the remainder is the intercalary remainder.

sentences.zh: 閏餘三百九十七巳上，若冬至不在其月，加積月一

translations.literal: If the intercalary remainder is three hundred ninety-seven or above, and winter solstice is not in that month, add one to accumulated months.
translations.idiomatic: If the intercalary remainder is 397 or above and winter solstice does not fall in that month, add one to the accumulated months.

sentences.zh: 推月朔弦望術：

translations.literal: Method for computing new moon, first quarter, full moon, and last quarter:
translations.idiomatic: Method for computing new moon, first quarter, full moon, and last quarter:

sentences.zh: 以月法乘積月，如法得一，為積日，餘為小餘。

translations.literal: Multiply accumulated months by the month divisor; divide by the divisor to obtain one, yielding accumulated days; the remainder is the small remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply accumulated months by the month divisor; divide by the divisor to obtain one, yielding accumulated days; the remainder is the small remainder.

sentences.zh: 以六十去積日，餘為大餘，命以甲子算外，為所求年天正月朔日。

translations.literal: Remove multiples of sixty from accumulated days; the remainder is the large remainder; count from jiazi beyond the tally—this is the new-moon day of the celestial first month of the year sought.
translations.idiomatic: Remove multiples of sixty from accumulated days; the remainder is the large remainder; count from jiazi beyond the tally—this is the new-moon day of the celestial first month of the year sought.

sentences.zh: 天正月者，建子月也，今為去年十一月。

translations.literal: The celestial first month establishes zi—now taken as the eleventh month of the prior year.
translations.idiomatic: The celestial first month establishes zi—now taken as the eleventh month of the prior year.

sentences.zh: 凡朔小餘五百四十七巳上，其月大。

translations.literal: If the new-moon small remainder is 547 or above, the month is long.
translations.idiomatic: If the new-moon small remainder is 547 or above, the month is long.

sentences.zh: 加大餘七，小餘四百三十七太；

translations.literal: Add seven to the large remainder and 437 plus three-quarters to the small remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Add seven to the large remainder and 437 plus three-quarters to the small remainder.

sentences.zh: 凡四分一為少，二為半，三為太。

translations.literal: One-quarter is "less," two-quarters is "half," three-quarters is "greater".
translations.idiomatic: One-quarter is "less," two-quarters is "half," three-quarters is "greater".

sentences.zh: 小餘滿日法去之，從大餘；

translations.literal: When the small remainder fills the day divisor, remove it and carry to the large remainder.
translations.idiomatic: When the small remainder fills the day divisor, remove it and carry to the large remainder.

sentences.zh: 滿六十去之，命如前，為上弦日。

translations.literal: When it fills sixty, remove it; count as before—this is the first-quarter day.
translations.idiomatic: When it fills sixty, remove it; count as before—this is the first-quarter day.

sentences.zh: 又加，得望、下弦、後月朔。

translations.literal: Add again to obtain full moon, last quarter, and the next month's new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Add again to obtain full moon, last quarter, and the next month's new moon.

sentences.zh: 朔餘滿五百三十七，其月大，減者小餘。

translations.literal: If the new-moon remainder fills 537, the month is long; if reduced, use the small remainder.
translations.idiomatic: If the new-moon remainder fills 537, the month is long; if reduced, use the small remainder.

translations.literal: Method for computing the twenty-four qi:
translations.idiomatic: Method for computing the twenty-four qi:

translations.literal: multiply by month divisor intercalary remainder, cycle yearsmall remainder,, divide by qi divisor to obtain one,, count from new moon beyond tally, Winter Solstice.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by month divisor intercalary remainder, cycle yearsmall remainder,, divide by qi divisor to obtain one,, count from new moon beyond tally, Winter Solstice.

sentences.zh: 不盡者，以十一約之，為日分。

translations.literal: divide remainder by eleven for day fractions.
translations.idiomatic: Divide remainder by eleven for day fractions.

translations.idiomatic: ：15, day fraction, small fraction1.

translations.idiomatic: Small fraction 8 carries to day fraction, day fraction full carries to days.

sentences.zh: 如月大小去之，日不滿月，算外，為次氣日。

translations.literal: remove according to month length,, beyond tally,.

sentences.zh: 其月無中氣者，為閏。

translations.idiomatic: Month without mid-season node is intercalary.

translations.idiomatic: Method for finding solar anomaly at new and full moon upon entering qi:

sentences.zh: 以入氣日算乘損益率，如十五得一，餘八已上，從一；

translations.literal: Multiply days since entering qi by the decrease-increase rate, divide by 15 to get one, if the remainder is 8 or above, carry 1; .
translations.idiomatic: Multiply days since entering qi by the decrease-increase rate; divide by 15 to get one; if the remainder is 8 or above, carry 1; .

sentences.zh: 以損益盈縮數為定盈縮。

translations.literal: Apply decrease or increase to the anomaly value to obtain the fixed anomaly.
translations.idiomatic: Apply decrease or increase to the anomaly value to obtain the fixed anomaly.

sentences.zh: 其入氣日十五算者，如十六得一，餘半法已上亦從一，以下皆准此。

translations.idiomatic: Method for computing the Earth phase:

translations.idiomatic: 27, day fraction, small fraction9.

sentences.zh: 小分滿四十從日分一，滿去如前，即分至後土始王日。

translations.literal: When small fractions fill forty, carry one to day fractions; when full, remove as before—this is the day when Earth begins to reign after the solstice.
translations.idiomatic: When small fractions reach 40, carry 1 to day fractions; when full, remove as before—this gives the day Earth begins to reign after the solstice.

translations.idiomatic: When full counts as days; remainder is day fraction; add days from new moon since entering qi; remove and count as before.

translations.idiomatic: Method for entering the slow-fast calendar:

sentences.zh: 以周通去朔積日，餘以周法乘之，滿周通又去之，餘滿周法得一日，餘為日餘，即所求年天正朔算外夜半入曆日及餘。

translations.idiomatic: To find the next month: add 2 days for a long month, 1 day for a short month; day remainders all 1,135; when full remove circuit day and day remainder.

translations.literal: To find the next day: add 1; when full, remove as before.
